pr.body:
## Summary
- W03 of MACRO-DMX-GOVERNED-EXECUTION-CONTRACT-V2-001, stacked on W01
- pure environment planner (repo identity, worktree, branch, allowed paths, filesystem scope)
- WriterCustodyReceipt authoring validated against writer_custody_receipt.v1; AMBIGUOUS on any unprovable fact
- L2 only: no live provisioning, credentials, permissions or egress; ESCALATE_W03B stop encoded and tested

MERGE_AUTHORIZED=NO ACTIVATION_AUTHORIZED=NO

requirements: Worktree /Users/hue/code/dopemux-mvp/.worktrees/gec-v2-w03, branch feat/gec-v2-w03-isolation-custody-001, 1c915b9141e9a5c3d835a5c7ea953381782ae875 ancestor of HEAD, clean tree except this packet; tests/governance/governed_execution passes (91).

EnvironmentSpec(repo_origin_url, repo_toplevel, packet_id, base_sha, branch, worktree_root, allowed_paths) -> plan_environment(spec) -> EnvironmentPlan with worktree_path = worktree_root/packet-derived slug, filesystem_root = worktree_path, allowed_paths normalised (sorted, deduplicated, no '..' or absolute paths; violation -> PlanRejected with reason), rollback_locality {strategy RESET_TO_BASE, boundary 'branch:<branch>'}.
Pure: no filesystem, no subprocess, no clock.

author_custody_receipt(plan, writer: WriterIdentity(runner, session_ref, agent_role), lease: WriterLease(lease_id, issued_at, expires_at), facts: ObservedFacts(head_sha, patch_bytes|None, outside_root_writes: bool|None, worktree_exists: bool|None, branch_matches: bool|None)) -> dict validating against writer_custody_receipt.v1.

custody_state = HELD only when worktree_exists, branch_matches and outside_root_writes is False are all provably True; RELEASED when lease expired (expires_at <= a caller-supplied now); AMBIGUOUS otherwise (any None).

allowlist_digest and diff_provenance.patch_sha256 computed by hashlib.sha256 as specified in invariants; filesystem_scope.outside_root_writes is always the literal False in the receipt (schema const) and a receipt is REFUSED (raise CustodyRefused) when facts.outside_root_writes is True or None.
test_plan: happy path; rejects '..' and absolute allowed paths; deterministic ordering.

test_custody_receipt: every authored receipt validates against the v1 schema via a local Registry built from schemas/governed_execution/*.schema.json; HELD/RELEASED/AMBIGUOUS branches; CustodyRefused on outside-root writes; digest equality against an independent hashlib computation; authority == 'NONE'.

test_l2_boundary: monkeypatch subprocess.run, os.chmod, os.umask and builtins.open to raise; every public function in the package still works on fixture input (proves no live side effects); a static test greps the package source for the forbidden tokens listed in the verify line and asserts zero hits.

Run every commit.verify line; all exit 0. Commit per slice. No push. If at any point the L2 trip-wire fires, stop and return STATUS=BLOCKED NEXT_LEGAL_ACTION=ESCALATE_W03B with the exact invariant that could not be proven at L2.
validation: Clean tree; section 16 return block; RISK_ACTUAL=L2; ESCALATED_TO_W03B=NO.
